data.title: 美杜莎 Rider · 海边长椅的无声读书会
data.description: 【远海防波堤·傍晚】美杜莎穿着黑紫泳装与轻薄长罩衫，侧坐在防波堤长椅上读书；她用一只手压住翻页，另一只手把海盐柠檬饮料递向镜头，长发沿着椅背被晚风吹成柔和的弧线。
data.location: quiet seawall at the edge of the sea
data.action: 防波堤长椅侧坐读书，递出海盐柠檬饮料，长发沿椅背被晚风吹起
data.lighting: low evening sun and lavender water reflections
data.promptProse: Medusa holds the book on her knee with her left hand, offering the lemon drink with her right. Low evening sunlight catches the glass, with lavender sea reflections on her shaded side as wind lifts her hair.
data.animaCaption: Her left hand holds the book on her knee; her right offers the lemon drink.
